name: Aseon Labs
sub: "Depot in a box" pitstops: charging, cleaning, inspection
regions: United States (early deployments inside operating zones)
leadership: George Kalligeros, co-founder and CEO; Dan Keene, co-founder
about: Y Combinator-backed startup building robotic pitstop infrastructure for autonomous fleets, a "depot in a box" that combines charging, interior and sensor cleaning, and inspection, deployed inside operating zones so vehicles turn around without deadheading to a central depot.
model: Sells/operates compact robotic pitstop stations for AV fleet operators.
deployment: Early-stage deployments; featured as vol. 1 of Ride AI's Ground Truth infrastructure series.
signal: Attacks the depot-density problem that caps robotaxi utilization, turnaround inside the zone instead of miles away.

sources.title: TechCrunch: Aseon Labs raises $10M to build pitstops that clean and charge robotaxis
